en.t: Beside the river stood a wall belonging to the main hall.

units.source_text: 破旧的瓦顶板心泥墙上芒草丛生。

en.t: On the dilapidated tile-roofed mud wall with a wooden core, pampas grass grew thickly.

units.source_text: 在夜色中，洁白的芒草花稳也是晶亮的。

en.t: In the darkness of night, the white plumes of the pampas grass also gleamed brightly.

units.source_text: 正殿的门旁，盛开着山茶花。

en.t: Beside the gate of the main hall, camellias were in full bloom.

units.source_text: 一行人默默地沿着河走去。

en.t: The group walked silently along the river.
